title: A Prey's View
description: When Lukas Andree Andersen visited Lake Kerkini in Greece, a famous wintering ground for the Dalmatian pelican, he figured he’d get close to these imposing creatures. He didn’t anticipate how close. After a pelican landed on the roof of his boat, it grabbed the photographer’s wide-angle lens with its pointy bill. “I just started shooting,” says Andersen, who somehow managed to frame the perfect angle of a pelican staring down at its prey. This photo is featured in the "In Focus" series in the July 2026 issue of National Geographic.
translated_description: 当卢卡斯·安德烈·安徒生造访希腊的凯尔基尼湖——卷羽鹈鹕著名的越冬地时，他本以为能近距离观察这些威严的生物，却未曾料到会如此之近。一只鹈鹕降落在他的船顶后，竟用尖喙叼住了摄影师的广角镜头。“我立刻开始拍摄，”安徒生说道，他竟奇迹般捕捉到了鹈鹕俯视猎物的完美角度。这张照片刊登在《国家地理》2026年7月刊的“聚焦”系列中。
